Item objects are view controllers, and you use their view hierarchies to display your content.
Items are the most common types of elements displayed by a collection view, and every collection view must have at least one type of item.
You use items to represent the main content of your collection view interface.
For example, a photo browser app would use items to display individual photos.
The actual data is always managed by your app and exposed to the collection view through the data source object, which uses the data to configure the items that are displayed.
